articles.title: Live tracking NFL free agency: Updates on signings, trades, cuts and rumors
articles.summary: NFL free agency opened Monday with the legal negotiating window. We're following all the moves as they happen.

articles.title: NFL free agency grades: Sizing up 30-plus big deals
articles.summary: We're handing out report cards on big moves, including the Mike Evans and Devin Lloyd signings.

articles.title: Sources: Tua to sign 1-year deal with Falcons
articles.summary: Former Miami Dolphins quarterback Tua Tagovailoa plans to sign a one-year deal with the Atlanta Falcons, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Source: Steelers add RB Dowdle on 2-year deal
articles.summary: The Steelers are signing former Panthers standout running back Rico Dowdle to a two-year, $12.25 million deal, NFL Network reported Monday.

articles.title: Seahawks keep Shaheed in fold with $51M deal
articles.summary: The Seahawks are bringing back wide receiver Rashid Shaheed on a three-year, $51 million deal that includes $34.7 million guaranteed, agents Drew Rosenhaus and Robert Bailey told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday.

articles.title: Star WR Evans leaving Bucs to sign with 49ers
articles.summary: Star wide receiver Mike Evans is leaving the Buccaneers to sign a three-year deal with the 49ers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Big-spending Raiders add Linderbaum, Walker
articles.summary: Free agent center Tyler Linderbaum reached agreement Monday on a record deal with the Raiders, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Giants address CB need, agree to sign Newsome
articles.summary: The Giants addressed their need at cornerback, agreeing with Greg Newsome II on a one-year deal worth up to $10 million, his agents told ESPN.

articles.title: Source: Packers add St-Juste to bolster CB depth
articles.summary: The Packers signed CB Benjamin St-Juste to a two-year, $10 million contract, a source told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Pats bulk up O-line, add Vera-Tucker
articles.summary: The Patriots bolstered their offensive line Monday night, agreeing to a three-year deal with the versatile but injury-plagued Alijah Vera-Tucker, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Source: LB Lloyd gets $45M deal with Panthers
articles.summary: Former Jaguars linebacker Devin Lloyd agreed to a three-year, $45 million deal with the Panthers, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday.

articles.title: Source: Dobbins back to Broncos for 2 years, $20M
articles.summary: The Broncos are bringing back running back J.K. Dobbins on a two-year, $20 million deal that includes $8 million fully guaranteed at signing, NFL Network reported Monday.

articles.title: Source: Super Bowl MVP Walker to join Chiefs
articles.summary: Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III has agreed to sign with the Kansas City Chiefs, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Busy Titans add WR Robinson, DL Franklin-Myers
articles.summary: Wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson reached agreement Monday with the Tennessee Titans, reuniting him with offensive coordinator Brian Daboll, his former coach with the New York Giants.

articles.title: Blankenship heads to Texans after Eagles stint
articles.summary: Former Eagles safety Reed Blankenship will sign with the Texans on a three-year, $24.75 million deal.

articles.title: WR Thornton agrees to $11M deal with Chiefs
articles.summary: Wide receiver Tyquan Thornton and the Chiefs agreed to a two-year, $11 million deal with a maximum value of $14 million, NFL Network reported Monday.

articles.title: Source: LT Jones back to Bears on 1-year deal
articles.summary: Left tackle Jones has agreed to return to the Bears on a one-year deal worth up to $10 million, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

articles.title: Cards reach deals with QB Minshew, WR Bourne
articles.summary: Former Chiefs quarterback Gardner Minshew reached an agreement Monday on a one-year, $8.25 million deal with the Cardinals, a source told ESPN.

articles.title: Commanders land Oweh on 4-year, $100M deal
articles.summary: Former Chargers defensive end Odafe Oweh, who has 17.5 sacks since 2024, has agreed with the Commanders on a four-year, $100 million deal, his agents told ESPN.

articles.title: Cops responded to 911 calls before Pearce arrest
articles.summary: In the weeks before Falcons linebacker James Pearce Jr. allegedly rammed his vehicle into WNBA player Rickea Jackson's car, at least seven 911 calls indicate heightened fears from his unidentified girlfriend that she was being stalked and harassed.

articles.title: Mike Evans' fit in San Fran? 49ers bring leadership to WR room amid renovation
articles.summary: Evans has agreed to sign a three-year contract with the 49ers, leaving the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after 12 seasons.
